Data:Nxh.n.heist.olympe.acted.olympe.hei.desc: 'None of it made any sense. So for a while I thought it was a fabrication. Why would someone break in and replace the items with forgeries? Why not just take them? It was difficult to fathom. But now I know that Dagmar von Nagelsburg has been disposing of her heirlooms to pay her debts... it begins to make sense. I can't prove it - and I won't publish it - but I'm pretty sure it was her.'

Data:Nxh.n.heist.zachary.acted.zachary.h.desc: 'Daymare entered the vault. Emplaced the forgeries. I don't know why. But the continuities are precise.'
'Daymare entered the vault. Emplaced the forgeries. I don't know why. But the continuities are precise.'

Data:Nxh.n.horizon.aladim.r.door.wall.js.desc: 'I have escorted their emissary out of the Bounds. The encounter was a useful reminder: Ys is beguiling; Ys is not malicious; but Ys is never to be trusted. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.horizon.aladim.r.seastories.j.desc: 'I have escorted their emissary out of the Bounds. The encounter was a useful reminder: Ys is beguiling; Ys is not malicious; but Ys is never to be trusted. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.horizon.dagmar.r.door.wall.fe.desc: 'Got shot of him. Been a bit of a fool about the whole thing til now, honestly. Always liked the idea of Ys - different kind of real, other kind of unreal, y'know. Beastly people though. Like teeth. I shan't elaborate. Like teeth.'

Data:Nxh.n.horizon.dagmar.r.door.wall.js.desc: 'Got shot of him. Been a bit of a fool about the whole thing til now, honestly. Always liked the idea of Ys - different kind of real, other kind of unreal, y'know. Beastly people though. Like teeth. I shan't elaborate. Like teeth.'

Data:Nxh.n.horizon.dagmar.t.aninvestigat.desc: 'Had a read of your book, had a think, decided to meet with the emissary. Don't worry, not going soft, know Ys has a reputation, all that. But look, got to take our allies where we find them, eh? That's just politics. And dinner parties. Seat 'em at the other end, sort of thing, keep the wine flowing. 'Not real, but not unreal like Nowhere.' Rather like the sound of it. And they're all so pretty. Anyway, thanks, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.horizon.dagmar.t.thekerishamp.desc: 'Had a read of your book, had a think, decided to meet with the emissary. Don't worry, not going soft, know Ys has a reputation, all that. But look, got to take our allies where we find them, eh? That's just politics. And dinner parties. Seat 'em at the other end, sort of thing, keep the wine flowing. 'Not real, but not unreal like Nowhere.' Rather like the sound of it. And they're all so pretty. Anyway, thanks, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.invisible.failed.hokobald.r.e.desc: 'Good. There were agreements made long ago, before even the fall of Rome. I would not see those agreements violated. Not until I am ready. I am bound for Venice, Librarian. You will not speak of it to anyone else.'

Data:Nxh.n.invisible.failed.hokobald.t.s.desc: 'Good. The morning frost will wither these silly flowers. I am bound for Venice, Librarian. You will not speak of it to anyone else.'

Data:Nxh.n.invisible.failed.morgen.r.sic.desc: 'Thank you, Librarian. There has never truly been war among the Hours - how could there be? - and so there will be no war now. But if I am lucky, one may inspired to shed the blood of another. Old injuries still rankle them as they do us...'

Data:Nxh.n.invisible.failed.morgen.t.ase.desc: 'Thank you, Librarian. There has never truly been war among the Hours - how could there be? - and so there will be no war now. But if I am lucky, one may inspired to shed the blood of another. It has happened before...'

Data:Nxh.n.invisible.salvaged.arun.t.aga.desc: ''A tower falls, a tower rises.' True; but sometimes, not true for a long time. I always wondered why the Calyptra had chosen flowers as their emblem, when flowers are so transient. I think they might yet come to regret it. Well, Librarian, I'm off to Venice.'

Data:Nxh.n.invisible.salvaged.arun.t.ann.desc: ''A tower falls, a tower rises.' True; but sometimes, not true for a long time. I always wondered why the Calyptra had chosen flowers as their emblem, when flowers are so transient. I think they might turn out to regret it. Well, Librarian, I'm off to Venice.'

Data:Nxh.n.invisible.salvaged.olympe.t.a.desc: 'The Madrugad is a power of balance, Librarian. When the balance is disturbed, she restores it. But she cannot always restore it right away…. and sometimes, as with the Winter Tower, the balance is righted in an unexpected way. I'm taking that lesson to Venice...'

'The Madrugad is a power of balance, Librarian. When the balance is disturbed, she restores it. But she cannot always restore it right away…. and sometimes, as with the Winter Tower, the balance is righted in an unexpected way. I'm taking that lesson to Venice...'

Data:Nxh.n.lark.azita.acted.azita.projec.desc: 'Stones! The secrets were in the stones of his workshop! Not in the Lark at all! And now they are free to the wind. Let us see what dissension that has sown.'

'''Stones! The secrets were in the stones of his workshop! Not in the Lark at all... but I had forgotten these stories you have given me. I heard them when I was only a girl… there is a sweetness in them. And it reminded me how dangerous it can be to meddle in these matters. Caution is not natural to those of us at the Edge. I have found Zuthi's trove, Librarian, but I have changed my mind. I will return them to the Hours of the Roost.'

Data:Nxh.n.lark.azita.r.skystories.acted.desc: 'Stones! The secrets were in the stones of his workshop! Not in the Lark at all! And now they are free to the wind. Let us see what dissension that has sown.'

Data:Nxh.n.lark.morgen.acted.morgen.proj.desc: 'Ramsund: of course. And the stones will tell over their hearts. I have Zuthi's trove. But you have reminded me, Librarian, how all this touches on my business. And my sisters' business. I think, after all, I will keep the secrets safe. For a rainy day, you say, no? For a rainy day.'
'Ramsund: of course. And the stones shall tell over their hearts. This will rekindle some piquant quarrels, Librarian! Don't worry. No-one will ever know you helped me.'

'Ramsund: of course. And the stones will tell over their hearts. I have Zuthi's trove. But you have reminded me, Librarian, of softer days... I think, after all, I will keep the secrets safe. For a rainy day, you say, no? For a rainy day.'

'Ramsund: of course. 'And the stones shall tell over their hearts'. I have Zuthi's trove. But you have reminded me, Librarian, how all this touches on my business. And my sisters' business. I think, after all, I will keep the secrets safe. For a rainy day, you say, no? For a rainy day.'

Data:Nxh.n.lark.morgen.r.skystories.acte.desc: 'Ramsund: of course. And the stones shall tell over their hearts. This will rekindle some piquant quarrels, Librarian! Don't worry. No-one will ever know you helped me.'

Data:Nxh.n.lark.serena.acted.serena.proj.desc: 'Of course: I shall use a courier. I have some ideas. Thank you, Librarian. Lest the Mansus shake…'

'You've reminded me, Librarian, of the perils of the contentions of the Hours, even when secrets stay where they should… perhaps we mortals should be a little less co-operative. I think I'll hang on to the secrets myself, for the time being. We could use the advantage.'

Data:Nxh.n.lark.serena.r.path.pilgrim.ac.desc: 'Of course: I shall use a courier. I have some ideas. Thank you, Librarian. Lest the Mansus shake…'

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.douglas.t.a.desc: 'Thanks, Librarian, but I can't find anything in there that'll help. Fair gives me the chills, too. 'Applebright'. Wish those things would stay nowhere. Got anything else?'

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.douglas.t.c.desc: 'Elie's in here, but all this tells me is she tried to do the right thing, back In the day… anything else?'

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.douglas.t.t.desc: 'Job done. Elie'd broken the Oblivate oath - not just the Iron Chain, all of them far's I can tell, but the Iron Chain's the one we could invoke. She won't be coming back to these islands any time soon.'

'Job done. We hadn't realised Elie'd been in Britain before - at Brancrug, even - or that our predecessors had tangled with her. (Long before Nocturnal Branch. Never mind who.) Our records go back a long way. (Never mind how far.) We found what she needed. She won't be coming back to these islands any time soon.'

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.fraser.acte.desc: Ys behind the wave, city of coral and ice… she met with Fraser, and he ensured that, willingly or not, she passed behind the wave in furtherance of Elie's bargain to protect the Bounds. Some day, we might know if that was a good idea. But today, Elie is pleased, and if we want to recruit her for our Institute, she's willing.

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.serena.r.ap.desc: 'Elie has had dealing with the Applebright. We can use that as a point of persuasion to drive her back across the sea… I'm not comfortable with this. But I don't want Ys to get any footholds. That's more important.'

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.serena.t.aj.desc: 'Elie has had dealing with the Applebright. We can use that as a point of persuasion to drive her back across the sea… I'm not comfortable with this. But I don't want Ys to get any footholds. That's more important.'

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.serena.t.co.desc: Yes, Elie did good work in her time. But I don't think that helps us now. Anything else?'

Data:Nxh.n.mystique.revealed.serena.t.th.desc: 'Of course: Elie has broken the Iron Chain. The Obliviates may have lost interest in punishing her, but I know King Crucible of old. She's strong enough to escape, but not strong enough to stand against him. She'll have to go into hiding. I don't like it, Librarian, but we can't let Ys get a foothold.'
''We had suspected Elie had come here, long ago - this place was a haven for Obliviates, not so long ago even - but I don't think that helps us now. Anything else?'
